description: This file defines the TalkModeManager class, which manages speech recognition and text-to-speech (TTS) functionalities within an Android application. It handles voice recognition, speech synthesis, chat session subscriptions, and integrates with a gateway session, supporting features like wake-word detection, conversation management, and TTS playback control.

classes.name: TalkModeManager
classes.description: Manages voice recognition, speech synthesis, chat subscriptions, and playback in an Android application, providing features such as wake-word detection, conversation handling, and integration with TTS and recognition services.

methods.name: ensureChatSubscribed
methods.description: Ensures the chat session is subscribed; reloads config and subscribes if needed.

methods.name: setMainSessionKey
methods.description: Sets the main session key for chat and message routing.

methods.name: setEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables the talk mode features, starting or stopping recognition accordingly.

methods.name: speakWakeCommand
methods.description: Coordinates the process of sending a wake-word command, receiving assistant response, and executing TTS playback.

methods.name: playTtsForText
methods.description: Plays the specified text as TTS output.

methods.name: handleGatewayEvent
methods.description: Handles incoming events from the gateway, updating chat or triggering speech as needed.

methods.name: setPlaybackEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables playback of TTS responses.

methods.name: refreshConfig
methods.description: Reloads runtime configuration settings.

methods.name: speakAssistantReply
methods.description: Speaks a given assistant reply text via TTS.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initiates voice recognition and listening mode.

methods.name: stop

methods.name: startListeningInternal
methods.description: Starts Android speech recognition with the configured intent.

methods.name: scheduleRestart

methods.name: handleTranscript

methods.name: startSilenceMonitor

methods.name: checkSilence
methods.description: Checks if sufficient silence has occurred to finalize recognition.

methods.name: finalizeTranscript
